title: hymenasplenium triquetrum
intro: Hymenasplenium triquetrum, commonly known as the Three-cornered spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Hymenasplenium triquetrum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
